summary: Suozzi stated in July 2026 that he 'unequivocally support[s] the State of Israel' and Democrats must 'continue standing firmly with Israel' during Netanyahu's Washington visit, and in September 2026 that he 'won't bend on Israel' as colleagues shift. In May 2024 he voted yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, directing use of the IHRA definition in Title VI education-discrimination enforcement.
